scope: Training-only first fixed model and exposure audit,after qualifiedT1. No V1 acquisition/output inspected,hardware action,new excitation,reference or controller tuning.
model: Same prespecified6-regressor two-axis first-order encoder-interval-velocity ARX used in round38: own/other previous interval velocity,present own/other time-weighted attempted current-count command,sign of previous own velocity,intercept.
grid: 1000actual20-control-sample intervals,20ms nominal,observed elapsed_us sums. Encoder differences/right sign from qualified header,command means from count*us integrals/elapsed_us. No interpolation to fabricate1ms inputs. Integer-us durations include MCU quantization.
fitWindow: Recorded intervals whose endpoint_ms is4000<end<=20000,phases2..5. First interval's prior state initialized from last measured prewindow interval. All800intervals retained; not only favourable motion segments.
selection: One fixed ordinary least-squares fit,columns scaled bytraining standard deviation. No delay/gain/order/threshold sweep. If linear autoregressive spectral radius>=1,flag inadmissible; do not project eigenvalues to force a pass.
diagnostics: SVD rank/condition,coupled linearA eigenvalues,one-step velocity and position errors,continuous16s recorded-input recursive position/mean/sync error,terminal error,input modal covariance rank,fast-window actual-vs-shadow excitation rank,interval timing/freshness. Same-training rollout is NOT validation.
exogeneity: Closed-loop/gated inputs and averaged interval data do not establish unbiased causal input-gain estimates; no IV consistency claimed. Do not claim calibrated torque,mass or independent carriage motion.
freeze: Preserve first fit and source/model/code hashes. Only report it as a candidate,not a validated plant. Do not fit/select using Q0 held-out context or V1 outputs.
budgetBoundary: Must define model-resolution budget linked to intended synchronization effect BEFORE independentV1. This audit does not invent a positioning tolerance or qualify a model for small controller-effect adjudication.
